title: Groups Of Special Equivalent Strings
description: Group strings where strings are equivalent if swapping characters at even/odd indices results in equality.
pseudocode:
1. Set = new Set()
2. for s of words:
3.   count = new Array(52).fill(0)
4.   for i in range(s.length):
5.     idx = s.charCodeAt(i) - 97 + (i % 2 * 26)
6.     count[idx]++
7.   Set.add(count.join('#'))
8. return Set.size

steps.note: Initialize an empty set to store unique character frequency signatures.
Calculating parity-based frequencies for 'abcd'. 'a' (even) at 0, 'b' (odd) at 1, 'c' (even) at 2, 'd' (odd) at 3.
Calculating parity-based frequencies for 'cdab'. 'c' (even) at 0, 'd' (odd) at 1, 'a' (even) at 2, 'b' (odd) at 3.
Returning the size of the set, which is 1.
